verdict.rationale: Versioning and deprecation policy are fair questions for an API gateway product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers routing, auth, BYOK, observability and OpenAI compatibility, but nothing about API versioning or a deprecation policy. An OpenAPI spec merely existing does not show versioning guarantees or deprecation terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
